name: Pertamina ECO Runfest
short_description: A World Athletics Label half marathon through central Jakarta, based at Gelora Bung Karno, with distances from 1.5 km up to 21.0975 km.
ai_summary: Pertamina Eco RunFest is a World Athletics Label road race held in central Jakarta, Indonesia, based around the Gelora Bung Karno complex and Istora Senayan. The 2026 event is its 13th edition, themed "Spark the Change, Leave Zero Trace", and offers four distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and a 21.0975 km half marathon. The organisers are targeting 14,000 runners and 10,000 visitors, and say all profit from ticket sales funds the event's environmental programme. The official site gives the 2026 race date as Sunday 6 December 2026.

core_facts.venue: Gelora Bung Karno and Istora Senayan, Jakarta

pros: World Athletics Label half marathon through central Jakarta
A real elite race at the front and 66 podium places across categories
Neatly run, with plentiful water stations according to runners' accounts
Family run and 5 km options alongside the half and 10 km
Early start, with the half flagged off at 4.45am in 2025
cons: Very humid: 94% humidity with a 24°C dew point at the 2025 start
Foreign runners limited to the Half Marathon Open
Places sold only through the MyPertamina app, with no refunds
Race packs must be collected in person or by proxy; missing collection counts as withdrawal
Route, elevation and water stations not yet published for 2026

faqs.question: Where and when does the Pertamina ECO Runfest take place?
faqs.answer: The Pertamina ECO Runfest is held in Jakarta, Indonesia, with the event scheduled for Sunday, December 6, 2026. As a city-based race, the course runs through the streets of Jakarta, one of the region's major capital cities, giving participants an urban running experience.

faqs.question: Is the Pertamina ECO Runfest an internationally recognized race?
faqs.answer: Yes, it carries a World Athletics Label, which is an official designation given to races that meet certain organizational and competitive standards set by the sport's global governing body. This makes it a notable event for runners seeking a certified international race.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Pertamina ECO Runfest?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options: a 1.5km fun run, a 5km, a 10km, and a half marathon at 21.0975km. This range allows casual participants, families, and more serious competitive runners to all take part in the same event on the same day.
